title: Run inspector quick tally
content:
Purpose: tiny personal sheet to capture per-run quick metrics and flag anomalies. Not official — notes to self and a place to paste quick outputs.

Columns:
date, run_id, model_variant, batch_size, tokens, avg_latency_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_est_usd, anomaly_flag, short_note

Rows:
2025-11-01, run-20251101-a, redwood-7B-q4, 8, 2048, 42, 28, 110, 0.021, none, baseline short-chat prompt
2025-11-02, run-20251102-b, redwood-7B-q4, 16, 4096, 61, 40, 190, 0.038, cpu-thresh, slight tail lat spikes around token 1500
2025-11-05, run-20251105-c, redwood-13B-fp16, 4, 1024, 88, 70, 180, 0.095, mem-warn, KV cache warm-up cost
2025-11-09, run-20251109-d, redwood-7B-q4, 32, 8192, 95, 60, 300, 0.065, batching-OK, good throughput but p95 high
2025-11-14, run-20251114-e, redwood-7B-q4, 8, 2048, 40, 26, 102, 0.020, none, repeated baseline run after config tweak
2025-11-21, run-20251121-f, redwood-13B-q8, 2, 512, 120, 110, 230, 0.16, mem-oom, killed on one host (trace attached)
2025-12-02, run-20251202-g, redwood-7B-ptq, 8, 2048, 36, 24, 95, 0.018, perf-win, quantized variant shows ~10% cost drop
2025-12-15, run-20251215-h, redwood-13B-fp16, 8, 4096, 105, 85, 210, 0.12, tail, p95 dominated by long completions
2026-01-07, run-20260107-i, redwood-7B-q4, 16, 4096, 58, 38, 185, 0.037, none, test with new batching policy
2026-01-21, run-20260121-j, redwood-7B-q4, 16, 4096, 74, 44, 210, 0.042, route-fallback, fallback to region-b triggered twice
2026-02-03, run-20260203-k, redwood-7B-q4, 8, 1024, 35, 22, 80, 0.017, none, low-latency short prompts
2026-02-18, run-20260218-l, redwood-13B-q8, 4, 2048, 95, 72, 205, 0.13, mem-high, near-limit but completed

Quick observations and scribbles:
- ptq run (2025-12-02-g) looks promising: 10-12% cost savings without obvious quality loss for convo prompts. Need more eval prompts + side-by-side diffs.
- Frequent p95 spikes correlate with long sequences (>1500 tokens) and cross-host preemption windows (see 2025-11-02 and 2025-12-15).
- 2025-11-21-f OOM: attach heapdump, check allocator flags; looks like rare memory leak in host image-2025-11-08.

To-do (short):
- Add prompt-set A/B for ptq vs q4 (owner: @Ava) — small eval harness
- File GH issue for region fallback incidents (run-20260121-j) with trace and route policy 
- Re-run runs with stable autoscaler off to isolate batching vs autoscale noise

Notes to self:
- This is intentionally compact. If something looks consistent, move to shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/benchmarks.
- Keep capturing 'cost_est_usd' using simple token*rate calc for quick triage (rate used here: $0.00001/token avg).

Attached scratch checklist: [x] capture p95 causes, [ ] schedule AB tests for ptq, [ ] open JIRA for OOM, [ ] push minimal notebook to /repo/scratch/run-inspector.ipynb

End of sheet (scratch).
